videos.title: You've Got Options | How to use native Windows 11 haptics on Logitech MX Master 4
videos.description:
Unlock native Windows 11 haptic feedback on your Logitech MX Master 4 without needing additional software.

In this episode of You've Got Options, learn how Microsoft's native haptic support brings subtle, tactile vibration feedback directly to your MX Master 4 on Windows 11. Existing users can unlock this capability via a quick firmware update in Logi Options+. Discover how native haptic feedback works across Windows 11 OS actions as well as third-party creative apps like Concepts.
